'''Polyps''' were tiny [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] lifeforms. On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]], thousands of polyps formed a communal consciousness that became the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] organism known as the [[Golden Sun]].<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
